risks: Input paper PDFs are not included, so tasks may lack source documents.
No numeric best score is reported, so difficulty remains unmeasured.
Reward hacking and contamination defenses are not discussed.

redistribution_questions: Can paper PDFs be redistributed? README says 'PDFs are not redistributed; ~20 min from arXiv'.

Can the ~3 GB of agent transcripts be bundled, or must they stay on the Hugging Face mirror? README says they are 'too large for git and are published with everything else in the Hugging Face dataset mirror'.
Are the cajohare/AxionLimits-derived ground-truth curves redistributable under MIT with attribution?
rights.quote: MIT (see `LICENSE`, `CITATION.cff`). Reference curves are from cajohare/AxionLimits (MIT, Ciaran O'Hare).

verifier.full_credit: Success rate = fraction of the 292 papers whose curve is within 10% (0.041 dex) of the reference; abstentions, wrong coupling types, unconvertible declarations and zero-overlap curves all count as misses.
